newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WELSH F.A. TO DISCUSS GOULD'S FUTURE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WELSH F.A. TO DISCUSS GOULD'S FUTURE.

text.p: Bobby Gould's future as Welsh national team manager will be discussed at an emergency Football Association of Wales committee meeting next Tuesday.

His position is under threat after striker Nathan Blake accused him of making racist comments during training for the March 29 World Cup qualifier defeat by Belgium. Blake refused a place on the substitutes' bench.
Gould immediately denied he was a racist but apologised for "any misunderstanding".
The FAW's eight-man management committee will consider the accusation and then report to the general council at its meeting in Wrexham the following day.
